question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The one who makes maps and charts
solution:
The correct answer is Cartographer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• Artist- A **person who creates paintings** or drawings as a profession or hobby
 
• Cartographer- A person **who draws or produces maps**.
 
• Geographer- An **expert in the study of the physical features** of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these.
 
• Sculptor- An **artist who makes sculptures**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to substitute for the group of words 'the one who makes maps and charts' is 'cartographer'.
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.
